newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-INJURED EALES NAMED BY AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED EALES NAMED BY AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Former national captain John Eales was on Tuesday named in the Australian team to face South Africa in the final Tri-Nations series match in Pretoria on Saturday.
Eales missed the 36-24 defeat against New Zealand in Dunedin last Saturday with medial ligament damage to his left knee.
"It will have to improve a fair bit if I'm going to play, but I'm hopeful," he said.
Coach Greg Smith said he was prepared to wait until the day of the match before ruling Eales out. If he doesn't make it John Langford, who replaced him against the All Blacks, will again stand in.

Queensland's Matt Cockbain is the only other change to the side that went down in Dunedin. Cockbain, usually a lock, has been selected on the side of the scrum in place of the injured Fili Finau. His only other test at flank was against the Springboks in Brisbane three weeks ago.
Australia will train at sea level in Durban for two days before flying up to Pretoria on Friday.

Australia: 15-Stephen Larkham; 14-Ben Tune, 13-Jason Little, 12-James Holbeck, 11-Joe Roff; 10-David Knox, 9-George Gregan; 8-Troy Coker, 7-David Wilson (captain), 6-Matt Cockbain, 5-John Eales, 4-Owen Finnegan, 3-Andrew Blades, 2-Michael Foley, 1-Richard Harry.
